description: Open source repositories with NO BOUNTIES that still credit reporters with CVEs (GitHub CNA or MITRE), ordered by newest stable release first.

repos.name: redaxo/core
repos.description: PHP and MySQL content management system in development since 2004, built around articles, modules and templates with an addon ecosystem. No bug bounty: the security policy asks only for private disclosure and offers no reward, and the project appears in no HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti or YesWeHack scope; advisories carry CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-53599). Latest stable release: 5.21.4 (2026-08-03).

repos.name: pterodactyl/wings
repos.description: Server control plane for the Pterodactyl game server management panel, running each game server in an isolated Docker container and exposing HTTP and SFTP APIs. No bug bounty program; the security policy promises only a public advisory, and reports are published as GitHub security advisories with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the finder by name (e.g. CVE-2026-52855). Latest stable release: v1.13.2 (2026-08-03).

repos.name: WeblateOrg/weblate
repos.description: Web based continuous localization platform with tight version control integration, used to manage translations for open source and commercial projects. No bug bounty: reports go through a HackerOne vulnerability disclosure program that pays no rewards, and fixes ship as GitHub security advisories with CVEs assigned by the GitHub CNA that credit the reporter by name (e.g. CVE-2026-50127). Latest stable release: weblate-2026.8 (2026-08-03).
